snippet.title: DOG®: The dog takes the hindmost - PC Gameplay (Steam)
snippet.description:
Looks like Ludo, but it's DOG®. In this game, you also have to safely bring your four game pieces into your home area. The difference is that they are moved using cards that have a few surprises in store for you. Team spirit is important, because you can only win together.

© Markt+Technik Verlag GmbH. 
Published by Markt+Technik Verlag GmbH. 
Developed by Korion Interactive GmbH. 
"DOG" and "Schmidt Spiele" are registered trademarks of Schmidt Spiele GmbH. All rights reserved.
Also released on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch
